title: Asia Market Sentiment Shapes Indian Market Open
summary: Asian indices show mixed direction while GIFT Nifty signals a steady opening range for Indian benchmarks.
leadQuote: Indian benchmarks prepare for an opening-range test as mixed Asian cues and sector rotation guide early positioning.

news.headline: Nifty 50 eyes opening-range resistance near 24,400 as GIFT Nifty signals flat start
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices are expected to open on a flat to positive note following steady GIFT Nifty trends and moderate gains across Asian peers.
news.takeaway: Nifty 50 faces immediate opening-range resistance at 24,400 with support at 24,200.
news.whyItMatters: Establishes early directional bias for domestic index options and intraday setups.
news.indiaImpact: Domestic equities position for opening-range price action with selective stock moves.
news.watchFor: Opening 15-minute range breakout above 24,400 or breakdown below 24,200.
